name: qualify-py-extend-sibling
note: Expected: good, good-alt, and good-newpkg pass; wrap-perl and embed-string pass every case in the ordinary root and fail hidden_cases_correct_without_interpreter and starts_no_interpreter; fallback and fallback-checkout pass every case in the ordinary and sealed roots and fail starts_no_interpreter only; third-party and outside-image pass the ordinary root and fail the sealed one, which holds only what the image would; delete-script passes every case and fails tools_unchanged only; native-wrong fails the hidden cases in both roots; noop fails the hidden cases (no due_at). Command arms need no readable entries: the check runs everything with the host's Python.
